svg.title: HNSW: hopping down the layers
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “HNSW: hopping down the layers” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A three-layer navigable small-world graph. A query enters at the sparse top layer and follows numbered red hops greedily down through the denser layers to layer zero, where the nearest neighbour is ringed in green.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
